findings.title: Unimplemented Phase 5 logic and TODO markers in research commands

evidence.observation: TODO marker indicating deferred Phase 5 authorization checking via Supabase
TODO markers indicating unimplemented Phase 5 integration with memory subsystems

proposed_action.description: Implement Phase 5 Supabase authorization checks and memory integration, or track via explicit issue backlog.

findings.expected_benefit: Eliminates placeholder logic and ensures proper authorization and persistence in research commands.

findings.title: Unimplemented query in quality forecasting module

evidence.observation: Empty list assigned with TODO comment to query quality_anomalies table

proposed_action.description: Implement the query against the quality_anomalies table in quality_forecasting.py.

findings.expected_benefit: Ensures quality anomaly forecasting accurately reflects historical anomaly data.

findings.title: Model router call log file missing

evidence.observation: Model router status reports log_file at /opt/starship-endeavour/core/model-router/call_log.jsonl, but call_log_exists is false

proposed_action.description: Configure or initialize the router call log path and ensure write permissions for telemetry collection.

findings.expected_benefit: Restores visibility and historical telemetry logging for LLM router calls.

findings.title: Direct API calls to external LLM providers bypassing model router

evidence.observation: Emergency alert feed makes direct call_gemini using GEMINI_API_KEY instead of routing through model router
Emergency alert feed makes direct call_mistral using MISTRAL_API_KEY instead of routing through model router

proposed_action.description: Route emergency alert LLM synthesis requests through the model router service to preserve centralized routing policy and audit logging.

findings.expected_benefit: Ensures centralized model routing policy, observability, and fallback handling for emergency alert feeds.
